parameters.query: select * from crud_models where model_name='{{ $('Get Model Name').item.json.model_name }}';

SELECT 
    c.column_name, 
    c.data_type,
    kcu.table_name AS foreign_table,
    kcu.column_name AS foreign_column
FROM information_schema.columns c
LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu 
    ON c.table_name = kcu.table_name 
    AND c.column_name = kcu.column_name 
    AND kcu.position_in_unique_constraint IS NOT NULL
WHERE c.table_name = '{{$node["Get Model Name"].json.model_name}}'
  AND c.table_schema = 'public';

INSERT INTO crud_models (
  model_name, 
  table_name, 
  primary_key, 
  allowed_fields, 
  schema_json, 
  allowed_ops,
  allowed_roles_select,
  allowed_roles_insert,
  allowed_roles_update,
  allowed_roles_delete,
  joins
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.table_name }}', 
  '{{ $json.table_name }}', 
  '{{ $json.primary_key }}', 
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.allowed_fields) }}'::jsonb, 
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.schema_json) }}'::jsonb, 
  '{{ "{" + $json.allowed_ops.join(",") + "}" }}'::text[],
  'ADMIN',
  'ADMIN',
  'ADMIN',
  'ADMIN',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.joins) }}'::jsonb
)
RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO crud_logs (model_name, operation, user_role, status_code, payload, response_summary)
VALUES (
  '{{ $node["Get Model Name"].json.model_name }}',
  '{{ $node["Get Model Name"].json.operation }}',
  '{{ $node["Security Validation"].json.user_role || "unknown" }}',
  {{ $json.error ? 400 : 200 }},
  '{{ JSON.stringify($node["WebhookCRUD"].json.body) }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ JSON.stringify({ count: $json.data?.length || 0, success: !$json.error }) }}'::jsonb
);

SELECT upper(uc.role) AS role
  FROM user_companies uc
  WHERE lower(uc.email) = lower($1::text)
    AND uc.id_company::text = $2::text
    AND uc.is_active = true
  LIMIT 1;
